title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: In 4-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$4$$ parts. Each part is used as a validation set once, while the remaining parts are used for training. Think about how many times each data point is used in training and validation.

title: Counting Training Uses
text: If you have $$4$$ folds, how many times is each data point used for training?

title: Validation Use
text: Remember, in cross-validation, each data point is used as a validation point exactly once. Consider how this affects the number of times it is used for training.
